disambiguation: Not merely a note-taking tool, Notelets transforms standard Markdown notes into interactive, functional mini-applications.
extras: Security Warning: Only import or run Notelets from sources you trust, as it executes frontend JavaScript with allow-scripts and allow-same-origin.
motivation: The author built it to make interactive mini-apps a native-feeling kind of note within the vault, rather than forcing Obsidian to imitate a browser.
problem: Obsidian notes are typically static documents, lacking the capability to function as interactive tools or mini-applications.
summary: Notelets allows users to import self-contained HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files or entire frontend projects into Obsidian notes, rendering them as interactive mini-apps.
